condition: Run only if no integrated generation qualifies for the original league-pool hold-out. This tests the observed direct matchup advantage of R3 independently; do not reinterpret it as a league promotion gate.
hypothesis: The single integrated R3 including backpass, width and time phases outperforms the active champion in fresh direct games.
primary: Raw own-versus-opponent league points in each actual fixture; 20,000 whole-seed bootstrap paired 95% lower bound >0; original 20ms deadline and raw reliability measures retained.
selection: R3 selected before these games based on earlier direct 5W2D1L,18–9 over8 development games. Thirty-two new seeds and both field/kickoff assignments give128 fixtures. No further policy changes allowed.
original_league_validation_seeds: Remain untouched; a direct result cannot authorize league promotion.
